authorization: User requested the proposed protocol as TeX/PDF and instructed implementation to begin on 2026-11-05.
parameter_status: Proposed reference assumptions adopted for initial implementation; not empirically established biological values.

fitness.before_day_zero: f_W=f_M=f_D=1; neutral turnover and mutation retained
fitness.theta_definition: gamma scale in days, greater than 0

observation.index_marker: largest positive baseline VAF at or before day 0 within one sample type; ties resolved by gene and variant, without using future expansion or outcome
observation.baseline_conditioning: condition on the measured initial positive VAF; baseline measurement uncertainty is not propagated in the initial implementation
observation.mapping: VAF=(M+D)/(2N), diploid heterozygous representative blood-cell sample
observation.measurement: normal logit(2*VAF), fixed sigma_vaf; no invented read counts
observation.zeros: excluded and flagged until a detection model is available; fitted data are positive-detection conditional
observation.other_values: VAF >= 50 percent excluded from this observation mapping
observation.clinical_label: one outcome per patient; missing outcome remains missing

implementation.joint_engine: hybrid deterministic M/(N-D) background and stochastic D forward filter; VAF weights and clinical event act on the same D distribution
implementation.unknown_clinical_outcome: use unrestricted D=0..N, not a killed distribution that implicitly declares no event
implementation.exact_event: killed D=0..K-1 chain with boundary flux at diagnosis time
implementation.interval_event: survival difference after the last VAF observation; post-event observations require a different model
implementation.clinical_full_fit: run only after source reconciliation; initial VAF-only fit is explicitly diagnostic
implementation.preliminary_vaf_fit: coupled mean-field approximation including mu and D_init; not the clinical joint likelihood
